description: This source file defines an internal class OracleCommandInterceptor that implements ICommandInterceptor. It provides methods to modify and set parameters on Oracle database commands, specifically handling Oracle-specific data types and settings such as BindByName, OracleDbType for Clob and Blob, and converting boolean parameters. The class uses expression trees to generate efficient, runtime-compiled lambda functions for setting properties on Oracle.DataAccess classes.

classes.name: OracleCommandInterceptor
classes.description: An internal class that intercepts and adjusts Oracle database commands to handle Oracle-specific parameter types and properties, such as BIND BY NAME and OracleDbType, ensuring correct behavior and data handling.

methods.name: BuildSetBindByNameAction
methods.description: Creates a lambda function to set the 'BindByName' property of an OracleCommand to true via expression trees.

methods.name: BuildSetOracleDbTypeAction
methods.description: Creates a lambda function to set the OracleDbType property (to Clob or Blob) of an OracleParameter via expression trees.

methods.name: Intercept
methods.description: Main method that modifies the command parameters, setting Oracle-specific properties such as OracleDbType and converting booleans to integers for Oracle compatibility.
